column1: # Test wallets held by this repo: deterministic, public test keys (src/tx.mjs, seed oak-chain-mock).
# Never use them for real value. Columns: role, address, key index for `oak-chain tx ... --index <index>`.
#   client-N  = oak-chain tx key --index N           (load-test client N)
#   prefix-HH = oak-chain tx key --prefix HH         (first test key whose address starts with byte HH)
# The prefix rows are precomputed because the --prefix search costs ~0.3 s per call; test/tx-shell.test.mjs pins this file.
